The codebase map is built at commit `ac7cb47`, and all 14 areas passed validation, so none are marked "not covered". `INDEX.md` is 56 lines.

- **Mapped:** api, claude, docs, e2e, github, root, scripts, src, src-app, src-features, src-graphql, src-lib, src-mocks, src-ui.
- **Retried once:**
  - root cited a line past the end of `CLAUDE.md`.
  - src-features cited `use-delete-task.ts` without its directory.
  - src-ui had three claims with no `file:line` citation.

  All three passed on the retry.

The validator confirms that every claim has a citation and that the cited file and line exist, but it doesn't check whether the claim is true. The first src-ui draft got through with one wrong statement: it said `ErrorBoundary` recovers by changing its `key` prop, but it actually reloads the page (`src/app/app.tsx:17`). The retry fixed that. When you review, check that the claims match the code, not just that the links work.

- Review and commit `docs/codebase-map/` yourself. `.build/` has its own `.gitignore`, so it stays out of git.
- To query the map, use `/ravn-agents:ask-codebase`. Don't add an `@docs/codebase-map` import to CLAUDE.md, because imports load on every launch; a one-line pointer is enough.
- A `SessionStart` hook will report areas that have gone stale. Refresh them with `/ravn-agents:onboard --refresh`.
